datasets.title: Yemen Assessment Data
datasets.description: The Task Force for Population Movement (TFPM) is a Technical Working Group to the Inter-Cluster Coordination Mechanism. (ICCM) The TFPM implements an information management tool that gathers data and location of displaced persons across Yemen.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/yemen-assessment-data-dtm]

lineage.description: The DTM (Displacement Tracking Matrix) dataset aggregates census-based assessments of internally displaced persons conducted by the Task Force for Population Movement across Yemen in multiple rounds. Data collection methodology involves direct enumeration and location tracking of displaced populations, with results compiled into baseline and round-based assessment files spanning multiple years.

resources.description: As of 01 Sep 2017, the TFPM has identified, 2,014,026 internally displaced persons (IDPs) (335,671 households) who have been displaced due to conflict since March 2015, dispersed across 21 governorates. For the same period, the TFPM has identified 956,076 returnees (159,346 households), across 20 governorates.
